fields.label: Buyer
fields.description: Buyer/institution name exactly as the advert carried it

fields.label: Buyer (Normalized)
fields.description: market_context.normalize_buyer key - gap math and watch matching group by this + category, never by raw name

fields.label: Category
fields.description: eTenders category as carried on the card - the second half of the buyer x category cell key

fields.label: Event Type
fields.description: The opportunities sync appends advert events; award/close exist for future Raw Tender Cache OCDS ingestion

fields.label: OCID
fields.description: OCDS release ocid / card tender_number - the sync dedupes advert events by this (one advert event per ocid)

fields.label: Event Date
fields.description: Advert: date_published (closing_date fallback); the gap math runs over these dates

fields.label: Stated Duration (Months)
fields.description: Contract duration parsed deterministically from the event's text (6-120 months band, noise-guarded); 0 = none stated

fields.label: Duration Source
fields.description: Where the stated duration was read from: advert_text or pack_text; empty when no duration was stated
